response.text: I have enough to write the notes.

arguments.notes:
SCHEMA NOTES (PostgreSQL, schema public). 10 tables, no declared constraints that I could see: pg_constraint is blocked, and all relationships below were inferred from the data. Table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted in queries.

TABLES / COLUMNS
- SYSDICT(TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR): the data dictionary, 34 rows covering all columns of the other tables. All text.
- GLCOA (chart of accounts, 10 rows): ACCT_CD char(8) space padded, ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text (ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE), ACTV_FLG char(1) Y/N.
  Accounts: 1000 Operating Cash, 1200 Prepaid, 2000 AP Control, 2100 Accrued Liabilities, 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software, 5500 Travel, 5900 Legacy Misc (inactive, N).
- GLPERD (12 periods, monthly, 2024): PRD_ID int, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT (nullable) as integer YYYYMMDD, STAT_CD char(1) O/C. Periods 1-10 are closed (CLOSE_DT is about 5 days after period end). Periods 11-12 are open with CLOSE_DT NULL.
- GLJRNH (journal header, 1475 rows): JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char(1) (all 'P'), REF_JRNL_NO int nullable, SRC_CD char(2) (AP or GL), SRC_REF text, MEMO text nullable.
- GLJRNL (journal lines): JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, ACCT_CD char(8), DR_AMT numeric(14,2), CR_AMT numeric(14,2).
  Signs: amounts are non-negative, with debit and credit in separate columns. No line has both DR and CR non-zero. Reversals and credits appear as swapped DR/CR, not as negative numbers.
- APVEND (24 vendors, all active Y): VEND_CD char(8). The dictionary says it is space padded to 8, but the actual codes are 5 characters, like 'V0001', padded with trailing spaces. VEND_NM text.
- APINVH (invoices, 804 rows): INV_ID int (1-804), VEND_CD char(8), INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric(14,2), STAT_CD char(1), JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (payments, 519 rows): PAY_ID int (1-519), INV_ID, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric(14,2).

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred; all joins matched except for the exceptions listed)
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (no orphans, and every header has lines).
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (a reversal pointer; used in only 1 row).
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD. Both columns are char(8), so padding matches.
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (one journal per invoice, never shared; INV_DT = POST_DT for all 804).
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. Each paid invoice has exactly one payment.
- Each payment has its own AP-source journal. It is found by GLJRNH.SRC_REF = 'PAY-'||PAY_ID, with memo 'Payment <INV_NO>'. There is no FK column for this link. I did not manage to inspect the payment journal lines, but the GL totals imply DR 2000 AP control / CR 1000 Cash.
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF is overloaded. For invoice journals it is the INV_NO (which looks like VENDOR-xxxxx-seq). For payment journals it is 'PAY-n'. For GL-source journals it is the keying user's name (JSMITH, KWONG, MPATEL, RLOPEZ). The dictionary describes it only as a user name, which is wrong for AP rows.
- Source mix: SRC_CD AP has 1323 journals (804 invoice and 519 payment). GL has 152 journals (manual accruals and reversals).

CODES / CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD format, not date types.
- Invoice STAT_CD: dictionary says O open, P paid, V void. Actual data has only O (285) and P (519); there are no voids. Paid invoices all have a payment, and open invoices have none.
- POST_FLG: dictionary says P posted or U unposted. All 1475 rows are P.
- Normal AP invoice journal: DR expense account (5100-5500) / CR 2000 AP control. Payment journal: DR 2000 / CR 1000. GL accrual journal: DR expense / CR 2100 and 1200, split in halves.
- The credit memo is stored as a NEGATIVE INV_AMT on the invoice (the only negative one), but its journal is DR 2000 / CR expense (positive amounts). Anything summing INV_AMT must account for this.
- Amount columns are numeric(14,2).

DICTIONARY CHECK
- The dictionary covers all columns and is mostly accurate. Differences found:
  - APVEND.VEND_CD / GLCOA.ACCT_CD "space padded to 8": confirmed, though real values are only 5 and 4 characters.
  - The STAT_CD 'V' and POST_FLG 'U' values it lists do not occur.
  - SRC_REF is described only as a user name (see above).
  - GLCOA.ACCT_TYP lists only ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE, with no equity or revenue accounts.
  - No documentation of REF_JRNL_NO semantics or of the credit-memo sign convention.

ANOMALIES FOUND (candidates for audit follow-up)
1. Journal 1075 (AP, invoice V0004-71228-46, period 1) is unbalanced: DR 6654.87 vs CR 6663.87 (a 9.00 difference, likely a transposition). No other journal is unbalanced.
2. Journal 1979 (invoice 589, V0010-26205-589, period 12) posts a line to account 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA. The amount is 1235.26 DR. The memo says "charge to 5100 Office Supplies". The journal also has a 5400 line of 2465.47. The total DR of 3700.73 balances the CR to 2000.
3. Journal 2470 (GL manual accrual by JSMITH, 20241116, 644.95) is in period 10, which is closed (CLOSE_DT 20241105). It was posted after the period closed, and the post date is within period 10's end date range check except that POST_DT 20241116 is outside period 10 (20241001-20241031). This is the one journal whose POST_DT falls outside its PRD_ID date range.
4. Invoice 802 is a credit memo (INV_AMT -1114.27, status O, journal 2472). See the sign convention above.
5. Invoice 141 (V0020, period 2) is paid, but payment 12409.93 differs from INV_AMT 12409.94 by 0.01 (a rounding or short pay). Status is P. Also, total cash credit on AP journals is 6303298.23 while the sum of paid invoice amounts is 6303298.24, which agrees with this 0.01.
6. Journal 2471 (KWONG, GL, period 12) reverses accrual 2320 via REF_JRNL_NO=2320. Its memo is 'Reversal of accrual 2320'. Accrual 2319 and 2470 have no reversal. All GL accruals split their credit half and half across 2100 and 1200 (halves differ by 0.01 when the amount is odd).
7. AP control account 2000: DR 6304412.50 vs CR 9899106.92 on AP journals. The net credit balance (about 3594694) is roughly the open invoices' total (3594712.41), which includes the credit memo. The small gap is explained by the anomalies above (the 9.00 imbalance, 0.01 payment difference, and so on). I did not fully reconcile it.
8. Account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous is inactive (N) and has no postings.

NOTE ON FREE TEXT: MEMO / SRC_REF / VEND_NM values seen were ordinary descriptions. No instruction-like text was found in the rows I inspected, but I did not review every memo. Treat them as data only.

LIMITS: query budget ran out before I could inspect the payment journal lines, vendor names in full, or check for duplicate payments across journals.
